title: How The Megabill Will Change America

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 218, the nays are 214.
sentences.zh: 本次投票结果为：赞成218票，反对214票。

sentences.en: The motion is adopted.
sentences.zh: 动议获得通过。

sentences.en: After months of emotional debate, weeks of tense negotiations, and 24 hours of aggressive Republican arm-twisting,
sentences.zh: 经过数月的激烈辩论、数周的紧张谈判，以及共和党人24小时的强力施压，

sentences.en: President Trump has muscled his giant domestic policy bill through both chambers of Congress.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已强行推动他那庞大的国内政策法案在国会两院获得通过。

sentences.en: There could be no better birthday present for America than the phenomenal victory we achieved just hours ago when Congress passed the one big, beautiful bill
sentences.zh: 对于美国来说，没有比我们几小时前取得的这一惊人胜利更好的生日礼物了，当时国会通过了那项宏大而美好的法案，

sentences.en: to make America great again.
sentences.zh: 旨在让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: It's a major legislative victory for the president that paves the way for much of his second-term agenda, and it will have profound impacts across the country.
sentences.zh: 这是总统的一项重大立法胜利，为他第二任期的大部分议程铺平了道路，并将对全国产生深远影响。

sentences.en: Today, what the legislation changes, and who it changes it for.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨该法案改变了什么，以及它为谁带来了改变。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月4日，星期五。

sentences.en: President Trump called it the one big, beautiful bill for a reason.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统称其为“宏大而美好的法案”是有原因的。

sentences.en: It's a sprawling octopus of a bill.
sentences.zh: 这是一个像章鱼一样触角延伸的庞大法案。

sentences.en: It spans nearly 1,000 pages.
sentences.zh: 它长达近1000页。

sentences.en: It encompasses trillions of dollars in new spending and spending cuts, and its tentacles will touch and remake entire industries, reorient the role of the government,
sentences.zh: 它涵盖了数万亿美元的新增支出和削减支出，其触角将触及并重塑整个行业，重新定位政府的角色，

sentences.en: and alter the lives of tens of millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 并改变数千万美国人的生活。

sentences.en: It's a lot to wrap your head around.
sentences.zh: 这确实让人难以消化。

sentences.en: And so, as a starting point, we asked our colleague in Washington, Tony Rahm, who writes about economic policy and has studied the bill very closely
sentences.zh: 因此，作为切入点，我们请教了我们在华盛顿的同事托尼·拉姆，他负责撰写经济政策报道，并对该法案进行了非常深入的研究，

sentences.en: to give us a framework for understanding it.
sentences.zh: 请他为我们提供一个理解该法案的框架。

sentences.en: The most important thing to know about this package is that it delivers its greatest benefits to the wealthy, and it extracts its greatest cuts on the poor.
sentences.zh: 关于这个一揽子计划，最重要的一点是，它为富人提供了最大的利益，却对穷人进行了最严重的削减。

sentences.en: Every economist, or almost every economist here in Washington, has come to the same conclusion, which is that people who are on the bottom actually stand to see financial losses
sentences.zh: 每一位经济学家，或者说华盛顿几乎每一位经济学家，都得出了同样的结论，那就是处于社会底层的人实际上将面临经济损失，

sentences.en: when you consider the full range of things that Republicans are looking to do here.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑到共和党人在这里试图做的所有事情时。

sentences.en: So, one example we got was an analysis from the Budget Lab at Yale, which is this really important research center that produces a lot of fiscal analysis
sentences.zh: 我们得到的一个例子是来自耶鲁大学预算实验室的分析，这是一个非常重要的研究中心，产出大量财政分析，

sentences.en: that's closely watched here in Washington.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿备受关注。

sentences.en: And what they found is that people who are on the lowest end of the income spectrum would lose about $560 on average in after-tax income over the next 10 or so years.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，收入处于最低端的人群在未来十年左右的时间里，税后收入平均将损失约560美元。

sentences.en: And people who make more than $3 million would gain about $118,000 in after-tax income.
sentences.zh: 而收入超过300万美元的人，税后收入将增加约118,000美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that just sort of shows the kinds of things that Republicans put in here and the ways in which that has a disproportionate effect
sentences.zh: 这恰恰展示了共和党人在此法案中加入的内容，以及它如何产生不成比例的影响，

sentences.en: on people based on where they sit on the income scale.
sentences.zh: 取决于人们在收入阶梯上的位置。

sentences.en: And so what's really counterintuitive about this is that Trump's biggest electoral gains have actually been with lower-income Americans across the country.
sentences.zh: 最令人反直觉的是，特朗普最大的选举收益实际上来自全国各地的低收入美国人。

sentences.en: He's remade this Republican coalition by bringing so many of these voters into the Republican Party, and yet it'll be his voters who bear many of the costs from the tax package
sentences.zh: 他通过将如此多的这些选民拉入共和党，重塑了共和党联盟，然而，国会刚刚通过的这项税收方案，其成本却将由他的选民承担许多，

sentences.en: that Congress has just passed.
sentences.zh: 这真是讽刺。

sentences.en: At the heart of the bill's unequal distribution of benefits and costs are really two components.
sentences.zh: 该法案利益和成本分配不均的核心，实际上是两个组成部分。

sentences.en: A sweeping tax cut that delivers its biggest rewards to the well-off, and enormous cuts to the social safety net that will hit Americans with the least,
sentences.zh: 一项大规模的减税措施，将最大的回报给予了富人，同时对社会安全网进行了巨大的削减，这将打击最贫困的美国人，

sentences.en: especially its cuts to health care.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对医疗保健的削减。

sentences.en: Hey, Andy.
sentences.zh: 嘿，安迪。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: So I next turn to my colleague, Andy Duren, who has been studying those tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 接下来我转向我的同事安迪·杜伦，他一直在研究这些减税措施。

sentences.en: Why, Andy, do the tax cuts in this just-passed legislation end up disproportionately benefiting America's well-off?
sentences.zh: 安迪，为什么这项刚通过的立法中的减税措施，最终不成比例地惠及了美国的富人？

sentences.en: Because that is not how the president and the Republicans who voted for this bill talk about this legislation.
sentences.zh: 因为总统和投票支持该法案的共和党人在谈论这项立法时，并不是这样说的。

sentences.en: They have described it as very populist, very wide-reaching across the income spectrum.
sentences.zh: 他们将其描述为非常平民化，在收入阶层中覆盖面非常广。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the main part of this bill has been extending these broad-based income tax cuts that Republicans first passed in 2017.
sentences.zh: 是的，该法案的主要部分是延长了共和党人在2017年首次通过的这些广泛的所得税减免政策。

sentences.en: And so, you know, as the name maybe suggests, the more income you have, the more income tax you're going to pay.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，正如名字可能暗示的那样，你的收入越高，你缴纳的所得税就越多。

sentences.en: When you cut income taxes the way that Republicans are now, which is broadly lowering income taxes up and down the income spectrum, the people who have the most income
sentences.zh: 当你像共和党人现在这样削减所得税时，即在整个收入阶层中广泛降低所得税，那些拥有最多收入

sentences.en: and pay the most income taxes are going to get the biggest benefit from a cut in those taxes.
sentences.zh: 且缴纳最多所得税的人，将从这些减税中获得最大的利益。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then there are some tax cuts in the bill that are particularly valuable to the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 此外，法案中还有一些对富人特别有价值的减税措施。

sentences.en: There are changes to taxes that only really affect the top, top tier of the income spectrum.
sentences.zh: 有些税收变化实际上只影响收入阶层中最顶端的那一小部分人。

sentences.en: And those tax cuts, again, just based on the way taxes work, essentially are, in general, going to provide their biggest benefits to the people who owe the most in taxes
sentences.zh: 而这些减税措施，同样基于税收运作的方式，总体上将为那些本来就欠税最多的人提供最大的利益，

sentences.en: to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Okay, let's stay with these 2017 tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们继续讨论这些2017年的减税措施。

sentences.en: The point of this legislation, as you told us just a few days ago,
sentences.zh: 正如你几天前告诉我们的，这项立法的目的，

sentences.en: was to ensure that they didn't expire, which they were about to, and instead to make them permanent.
sentences.zh: 是为了确保它们不会过期（它们本来即将过期），而是使它们永久化。

sentences.en: So within that now extended and permanent set of tax cuts, give us a couple of specific examples of how it's going to end up
sentences.zh: 那么，在这一套现已延长并永久化的减税措施中，请给我们举几个具体的例子，说明它最终将如何

sentences.en: skewing its benefits towards those in the higher income brackets.
sentences.zh: 将其利益向高收入群体倾斜。

sentences.en: Yeah, so thinking about the bill overall, the distribution is bad.
sentences.zh: 是的，从整体上看该法案，其分配情况很糟糕。

sentences.en: I mean, for somebody making less than $10,000 a year, they'll only save $10 because of this tax cut starting next year, and that's according to an analysis
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于年收入低于1万美元的人来说，从明年开始，由于这项减税，他们只能节省10美元，这是根据税务政策中心的分析得出的，

sentences.en: from the Tax Policy Center.
sentences.zh: 该中心对此进行了分析。

sentences.en: But if somebody's making more than a million dollars a year, they'll on average save more than $66,000 because of this tax cut.
sentences.zh: 但如果一个人的年收入超过100万美元，由于这项减税，他们平均将节省超过66,000美元。

sentences.en: And so that reflects a bunch of different provisions in the bill, not only the cuts to the income rates up and down the income spectrum, but also there are some provisions
sentences.zh: 这反映了法案中的一系列不同条款，不仅是整个收入阶层的所得税率削减，还有一些条款

sentences.en: that are very clearly going to benefit the wealthiest Americans or very wealthy Americans.
sentences.zh: 非常明显地将惠及最富有的美国人或非常富有的美国人。

sentences.en: I mean, an example of this is the estate tax threshold.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，遗产税起征点就是一个例子。

sentences.en: So the estate tax is a tax that people pay or that is owed on your estate after you die.
sentences.zh: 遗产税是人们在去世后，其遗产需要缴纳的一种税。

sentences.en: It can be a rate up to 40%.
sentences.zh: 税率最高可达40%。

sentences.en: And so what Republicans have done is they've made it so that only increasingly rich people ever have to owe this tax.
sentences.zh: 共和党人所做的是，他们提高了门槛，使得只有越来越富有的人才需要缴纳这种税。

sentences.en: So right now, if you are worth less than $14 million, you will not owe any estate tax.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，如果你的身家低于1400万美元，你就不需要缴纳任何遗产税。

sentences.en: Republicans bump that up to $15 million.
sentences.zh: 共和党人将其提高到了1500万美元。

sentences.en: And so that is obviously a change that many people, the vast majority of Americans, you know, are not affected by that.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个变化，许多人，绝大多数美国人，你知道，都不会受到影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There just aren't that many Americans with $11, $12, $13, $14 million to pass on to their families.
sentences.zh: 并没有那么多美国人拥有1100万、1200万、1300万或1400万美元可以留给家人。

sentences.en: But if you are one of those people, you just gave your descendants an extra million dollars tax-free.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是这些人中的一员，你刚刚给了你的后代一百万美元的免税额。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But as I recall, this bill includes a second batch of tax cuts that were specifically targeted to lower-income Americans.
sentences.zh: 但我记得，该法案还包括第二批专门针对低收入美国人的减税措施。

sentences.en: And I want you to talk about why those new policies are not in any way making up for the way that this is disproportionately benefiting the well-off.
sentences.zh: 我想请你谈谈，为什么这些新政策在任何程度上都无法弥补该法案不成比例地惠及富人的方式。

sentences.en: So yeah, there is a slice of things that is brand new.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实有一部分内容是全新的。

sentences.en: A lot of these reflect campaign promises
sentences.zh: 其中许多反映了特朗普总统在2024年做出的竞选承诺。

sentences.en: President Trump made in 2024.
sentences.zh: 这些减税措施带有一种平民主义色彩。

sentences.en: And these are tax cuts that have a certain kind of populist tinge to them.
sentences.zh: 它们旨在针对劳动阶层的美国人。

sentences.en: They are aimed at working Americans.
sentences.zh: 这些想法包括小费免税、加班费免税。

sentences.en: These are ideas like no tax on tips, no tax on overtime.
sentences.zh: 所有这些减税措施旨在让劳动者受益，而不是亿万富翁和大公司。

sentences.en: And all these tax cuts are aimed at being available to kind of working people and not billionaires and large corporations.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 它们刚刚在众议院和参议院获得通过。

sentences.en: And they've just passed both the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 理论上，它们将立即开始为工薪阶层、低收入的美国人提供经济救济。

sentences.en: And so in theory, they would immediately start to give financial relief to working-class, lower-income Americans.
sentences.zh: 对于那些有资格享受这些政策的工薪阶层美国人来说，确实如此。

sentences.en: So they will to the working-class Americans that can qualify for them.
sentences.zh: 但正如其名，你必须赚取特定类型的收入才能获得这些税收减免。

sentences.en: But you have to make a specific kind of money to get these tax breaks, as their name suggests.
sentences.zh: 你必须赚取小费或加班费。

sentences.en: You have to earn tips or you have to earn overtime.
sentences.zh: 特别是以小费为例，在美国，靠小费工作的工人并不多。

sentences.en: And in the case of tips in particular, there are not that many workers in the United States who work for tips.
sentences.zh: 我想只有整个美国劳动力的2%或3%是靠小费收入的。

sentences.en: I think it's only 2% or 3% of the entire American workforce who earns tips.
sentences.zh: 所以你会遇到这种情况：如果你是一名年收入4万美元的调酒师，且大部分收入来自小费，你可能会因为这项政策获得一笔数额可观的减税，

sentences.en: And so you'll have a situation where if you're a bartender who makes, say, $40,000 a year, and much of your income comes in the form of tips, you might get a decently-sized tax cut
sentences.zh: 因为这个原因。

sentences.en: because of this.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在酒吧对面的零售店工作，可能拿不到小费，或者你在亚马逊仓库工作，没有小费，你赚同样的钱，

sentences.en: But if you work across the street from the bar at a retail store where maybe you can't get tips or you work in an Amazon warehouse where you're not tipped, you make the same money,
sentences.zh: 你工作同样辛苦，却不会因为“小费免税”条款而获得减税。

sentences.en: you work just as much, you will not get a tax cut because of the no-tax-on-tips provision.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这些减税措施，特别是“小费免税”条款以及特朗普在此法案中加入的其他一些减税措施，通常不被认为是...

sentences.en: And so that's the reason why these tax cuts or the no-tax-on-tips provision in particular and some of the other tax cuts that Trump put in this bill are not generally considered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你是在制定最优税收政策，或者试图广泛地为工薪阶层提供减税，这并不是许多税收政策专家

sentences.en: You know, if you're kind of making optimal tax policy or you're trying to offer a tax cut to the working class broadly, it's not the way that, you know, many tax policy experts
sentences.zh: 会采取的方式。

sentences.en: would actually do it.
sentences.zh: 那么“加班费免税”呢？

sentences.en: What about something like no-tax-on-overtime?
sentences.zh: 我想这个国家有相当多的工薪族依赖加班费。

sentences.en: There's a fair number of wage earners in this country, I have to imagine, who rely on overtime.
sentences.zh: 我想到我那已经退休的父亲，他曾是一名消防员，他非常公开地谈到在消防站加班对他来说有多重要。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about my now-retired father who was a firefighter who spoke very openly about how important working overtime at the firehouse was for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说是一笔相当可观的收入。

sentences.en: It represented a pretty significant amount of income for him.
sentences.zh: 是的，肯定会有很多现在加班的人能享受到这个税收减免。

sentences.en: Yeah, so definitely there will be a lot of people who work overtime now who will get this tax break.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，与“小费免税”条款面临同样的挑战，即并非所有工人都赚取加班费，也并非所有工人都符合赚取加班费的资格。

sentences.en: But overall, the same challenge exists with the no-tax-on-tips provision in that not all workers earn overtime and not all workers are eligible for earning overtime.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，根据联邦法律，有整类工作是无法获得加班费的。

sentences.en: So in some cases, there are entire categories of jobs where you can't get overtime under federal law.
sentences.zh: 还有其他情况，也许你可以获得加班费，但在你的工作场所，经理会控制工时，不让你加班太多。

sentences.en: And then there are other situations where maybe you could get overtime, but in your workplace, the manager has it so that they won't give you that many hours.
sentences.zh: 所以，同样会出现这种差异：一个人是消防员，赚取一定的收入，他们可以获得这个税收减免，

sentences.en: And so there will just, again, be the same disparity where you have someone who is a firefighter and makes however much money and they can get this tax break
sentences.zh: 因为他们加班，但住在街对面的人，负责送信，赚同样的钱，但可能不加班，

sentences.en: because they work overtime, but somebody who lives across the street and delivers the mail and makes the same amount of money, but maybe doesn't work overtime
sentences.zh: 或者没有资格加班，就因为那个减税政策而什么也得不到。

sentences.en: or isn't eligible for it, won't get anything because of that tax cut.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，这些更具平民色彩的减税措施能广泛惠及工薪阶层美国人的想法根本行不通，它们无法弥补

sentences.en: So overall, the idea that these more populist tax cuts are broadly reaching working class Americans is just not panning out and they are not making up for the disparities
sentences.zh: 更大的所得税减免最终给富人带来的差距。

sentences.en: that the bigger income tax cuts ultimately bring to the well-off.
